title: 第96章 咱们互相帮助，柔雪的去处

第96章 咱们互相帮助，柔雪的去处-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“这是做的什么面，好香啊！”李青山望着铁锅内正在煮的面，开口问道。

不得不说。

柔雪在做饭这方面，确实是有一手的！

就比如眼前这一锅简简单单的面条，这小味道，简直绝了。

“炝锅面！”

柔雪声音细声温柔道：“以前，我家里会经常做，我就跟着学会了。”

炝锅面很快上桌。

李青山迫不及待夹了一筷子放入口中，果然，满口葱花和鸡蛋的浓郁香味融合，还有柿子的酸甜味进行中和后，入口喷香又无刺激性的味道，简直绝了！

这炝锅面需要将葱花煸炒发黄，放入番茄丁，倒热水，放入鸡蛋，酱油，面条，熬煮过后的面条汤汁浓郁。

真是开胃啊！

李青山一连吃了两碗都没吃饱。

可惜，铁锅里已经没了。

“我再做两碗吧！”柔雪急忙又要忙活起来。

“别了，以前早上都不吃饭的，吃得太饱也不好干活，大壮他们也来了，我也得赶紧出门了。”

李青山说话期间，大壮和赵红旗他们果然推着车来了，动静还不小。

“快去休息吧！”

李青山背过大门口，低头朝着柔雪的额头亲了一口，刚刚进来的大壮和赵红旗只能看到李青山的背影，娇小身段的柔雪完全被李青山的魁梧身体遮挡住。

这几日打一打养生拳，吃的营养也上来后，原本干瘦的身体也逐渐魁梧了起来，再过两三个月，李青山估计自己的身体就能够恢复巅峰期，浑身腱子肉，六块腹肌。

“山哥，车子推在门外了，电瓶呢？”大壮开口喊道。

“大壮，小点声，三叔和三婶他们还都在休息。”赵红旗提醒了一声道。

相比于大壮和二壮的憨厚，大大咧咧，赵红旗的心思明显更细腻一些，也更成熟一些，毕竟现在的赵红旗都已经当了爹，家中还有病重的母亲，若是他再不稳当一些，这个家恐怕早就散了。

“电瓶在我房间里，你们搬上去，还有院子里晾着的几个袋子也拿着，记着再带两个水桶，今天说不定能够派上用场。”

李青山开口吩咐道。

大壮等人纷纷开始忙活起来，李青山低头望着柔雪道：“自从吃了你做的饭后，我娘做的饭我都快吃不下去了。”

"What kind of noodles are these? It smells so good!" Li Qingshan asked, looking at the noodles being cooked in the iron pot.

I have to say.

Rouxue is indeed good at cooking!

Just like the simple pot of noodles in front of you, the taste is simply amazing.

“Soy pot noodles!”

Rouxue said in a soft voice: "In the past, my family would often do it, so I learned how to do it."

The hot pot noodles were served quickly.

Li Qingshan couldn't wait to pick up a chopstick and put it into his mouth. Sure enough, his mouth was full of the rich aroma of chopped green onions and eggs, and the sour and sweet taste of persimmons were balanced out. The taste was fragrant and non-irritating. It was simply amazing!

For this hot pot noodles, you need to stir-fry chopped green onions until brown, add diced tomatoes, pour hot water, add eggs, soy sauce, and noodles. After cooking, the noodles will have a rich soup.

How appetizing!

Li Qingshan ate two bowls in a row without feeling full.

Unfortunately, the iron pot is gone.

"Let me make two more bowls!" Rouxue hurriedly started to work again.

"Farewell, I didn't eat in the morning before. It was hard to work if I was too full. Da Zhuang and the others are here too, so I have to go out quickly."

While Li Qingshan was talking, Da Zhuang, Zhao Hongqi and the others came with a cart as expected, and there was quite a lot of movement.

"Go and rest!"

Li Qingshan turned his back to the door, lowered his head and kissed Rouxue on the forehead. Da Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi, who had just entered, could only see Li Qingshan's back. Rouxue, with her petite figure, was completely obscured by Li Qingshan's burly body.

After doing some health-preserving boxing and eating more nutrients in the past few days, his originally skinny body has gradually grown stronger. In two or three months, Li Qingshan estimates that his body will be back to its peak, with muscles all over his body and six-pack abs.

"Brother Shan, the car is pushed outside the door. Where is the battery?" Da Zhuang shouted.

"Da Zhuang, please keep your voice down. Third uncle and third aunt are still resting." Zhao Hongqi reminded.

Compared to Da Zhuang and Er Zhuang, who are honest and carefree, Zhao Hongqi is obviously more delicate and mature. After all, Zhao Hongqi is now a father and has a seriously ill mother at home. If he had been less stable, the family would have broken up long ago.

"The battery is in my room. You can carry it up, as well as a few bags hanging out in the yard. Remember to bring two more buckets. They might come in handy today."

Li Qingshan opened his mouth and gave instructions.

Da Zhuang and others began to work one after another. Li Qingshan looked down at Rouxue and said: "Since I ate the food you cooked, I can hardly eat the food cooked by my mother."
